title: Path and Bone-Contour Regularized Unpaired MRI-to-CT Translation
tldr_zh: 无配对 MRI→CT：共享潜空间 θ 连续生成器 + 逐层 Jacobian 路径长度正则 + 可训练骨轮廓正则，三数据集 PSNR/SSIM 最优，骨 Dice 0.84 vs 0.81
tldr_en: Unpaired MRI-to-CT via shared latent space, theta-conditioned generator with layer-wise Jacobian path-length regularization and a learned bone-contour loss; best PSNR/SSIM on three datasets, bone Dice 0.84 vs 0.81.
key_numbers: Pelvic (Gold Atlas): PSNR 28.52 / SSIM 90.56 / LPIPS 0.0915 vs Senta 27.73 / 88.34 / 0.1174, SynDiff 26.02 / 89.68 / 0.0999 (Table 1)
Head: PSNR 23.74 / SSIM 86.72 vs SynDiff 22.90 / 85.58, Senta 22.93 / 85.10 (Table 1)
SynthRAD2023 brain: PSNR 25.44 vs SynDiff 24.97; LPIPS 0.1365 vs SynDiff 0.1331 (Table 1)
Bone segmentation Dice (head, HU>300): PaBoT 0.84±0.06 vs SynDiff 0.81, Senta 0.81, CycleGAN 0.76, CUT 0.32 (Table 2)
Sobel MRI edges instead of learned G_bone: head 23.23 vs 23.74 (Table 5)
Loss weights: recon 5.0, adv 1.0, path 0.1, contour 5.0; h ~ U(0.1,0.2) (Sec. 3.2, 4.2)
